```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
# Reuse the analysis library shipped alongside this report. Load only its
# functions because sys.nframe() guards its command-line entry point.
analysis_lib <- file.path(
  dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)),
  "FreesurferAnalysisScript.R"
)
source(analysis_lib)
zscore_track <- identical(params$track, "zscores")
```

## Overview

```{r overview, results="asis"}
if (zscore_track) {
  cat(paste(
    "This report compares BrainCharts normative z-scores between cohorts with",
    "per-region Welch t-tests and Hedges g across four contrasts: pain vs",
    "control, no-pain vs control, pain vs no-pain, and pooled SCI vs control.",
    "It analyzes the cortical thickness (Z_SCI) and subcortical volume (Z_SUB)",
    "z-score blocks and requires one table for each block and contrast, for",
    "eight tables total."
  ))
} else {
  cat(paste(
    "This report runs per-region Welch t-test and Hedges g comparisons across",
    "four cohort contrasts: pain vs control, no-pain vs control, pain vs",
    "no-pain, and pooled SCI vs control. It analyzes the cortical (SCI),",
    "subcortical (SUB), and white matter (WM) measure blocks and requires one",
    "table for each block and contrast, for twelve tables total. It also",
    "summarizes intracranial volume and mean cortical thickness by cohort and",
    "site. Raw volumes are not adjusted for head size."
  ))
}
```

If a block or contrast cannot estimate any region, the report stops with the
missing result-family name and its reason. The tables report unadjusted
per-region inference. The implementation applies no multiplicity correction or
covariate adjustment and omits missing regional values per comparison. Each
result family requires at least one region with two observations per group.
Treat these outputs as study-specific research results that require
statistical review; they do not provide individual or clinical interpretation.
The sourced analysis rejects any input CSV above 64 MiB, 5,000 cohort rows, or
1,024 columns before reading the full table. It also rejects invalid
nonmissing regional values instead of silently dropping them. The command-line
wrapper renders into an unpublished destination-filesystem generation and
switches the public output path only after every table and this report
succeed.

```{r run-analysis}
analysis <- if (zscore_track) {
  run_zscore_analysis_in_place(
    zscores_csv = params$zscores_csv,
    out_dir = params$out_dir,
    cohorts = params$cohorts
  )
} else {
  run_analysis_in_place(
    structural_dir = params$structural_dir,
    metadata_csv = params$metadata_csv,
    out_dir = params$out_dir,
    start_column = params$start_column,
    cortical_split = params$cortical_split,
    cohorts = params$cohorts
  )
}
```

## Effect direction

```{r direction, results="asis"}
cat(paste(direction_text(params$cohorts), collapse = "\n\n"))
```

## Sites

```{r sites, results="asis"}
if (zscore_track) {
  cat(zscore_site_text(analysis))
} else {
  cat(paste(site_text(analysis), collapse = "\n\n"))
  if (length(analysis$site_labels) >= 2) {
    counts <- analysis$site_counts
    wide <- reshape(
      counts, idvar = "Site", timevar = "Cohort", direction = "wide"
    )
    names(wide) <- sub("^N\\.", "", names(wide))
    cat("\n\n")
    print(knitr::kable(wide, row.names = FALSE))
  }
}
```

## Result tables

```{r results-summary, results="asis"}
result_bases <- if (zscore_track) {
  as.vector(outer(
    paste0("Z_", c("SCI", "SUB")),
    c("PvH", "nNPvH", "nNPvP", "IvH"),
    function(block, comparison) paste0(block, "_", comparison, "_results")
  ))
} else {
  as.vector(outer(
    c("SCI", "SUB", "WM"),
    c("PvH", "nNPvH", "nNPvP", "IvH"),
    function(block, comparison) paste0(block, "_", comparison, "_results")
  ))
}
result_candidates <- unlist(lapply(
  result_bases,
  function(base) file.path(params$out_dir, paste0(base, c(".xlsx", ".csv")))
))
if (!zscore_track) {
  result_candidates <- c(
    result_candidates,
    file.path(
      params$out_dir,
      c("site_exclusions.csv", "summary_icv.csv", "summary_thickness.csv")
    )
  )
}
results_files <- basename(
  result_candidates[file.exists(result_candidates)]
)
if (length(results_files) == 0) {
  cat("Check the cohort labels and inputs to produce result tables.\n")
} else {
  cat(paste0("- `", results_files, "`", collapse = "\n"))
}
```
